How the game works:
- Each button turns one ring of coloured blocks. The "8" half turns it counter-clockwise by one step. The "e" half turns it clockwise by one step.
- The two rings share two cells, one at the top middle and one at the bottom middle. You use these cells to move a block from one ring to the other.
- To win, put the bb block in the slot between the b markers (left). Put the cc block in the slot between the c markers (right).

My first guess was the reverse: cc on the left and bb on the right. I tried it and it did not work, and that cost about 17 extra actions. I also spent 3 test clicks.
